text:
ada: quick follow-up from today's spike proposing a small streaming-verify contract for chunked safetensors bundles. goal: let inference start using verified chunks as they appear while ensuring cryptographic chain integrity and simple rollback.
jun: important to avoid any silent mismatch between verified and unverified chunks. outline the proposed contract?
mike: sketch: each chunk has a chunk_id, offset, length, and sig. the bundle carries a top-level signed manifest that commits to chunk ordering and a per-chunk rolling-hash chain so we can verify partial prefixes.
leah: so runtime can stream-verify chunks in order and mark prefix_verified up to N. unverified suffix remains read-only and falls back to previous bundle.
ada (typo): ada: yep. runtime API: verify_prefix(max_chunks) -> verified_upto_chunk_id; apply_chunks(chunk_ids[]) -> atomic apply to layer slab; mark_layer_committed(layer_id) -> bool. if apply fails we rollback applied chunks for that layer.
mike: detail: signature chain example (proposal):
```json
{
  "manifest_sig": "ed25519:<b64>",
  "chunks": [
    {"id":"c0","offset":0,"len":4194304,"sig":"ed:<b64>","chain_hash":"sha256:<hex>"},
    {"id":"c1","offset":4194304,"len":4194304,"sig":"ed:<b64>","chain_hash":"sha256:<hex_of_prev|this>"}
  ]
}
```
leah: chain_hash lets us detect out-of-order or truncated streams. but we need to define how to treat a bad chunk: immediate abort for that layer? or skip and try refetch?
jun: prefer retry-first for network blips, but if sig fails we should mark layer as corrupt and fall back to previous committed layer. can't risk unsigned params.
mike: quant nuance: quant metadata must be verified before mapping to GPU pages. propose a preliminary validate_chunk_meta(chunk_id) that validates quant_bits, group_size, and per-chunk scale table checksum. runtime should refuse to apply chunk if metadata mismatch.
leah: memory model: streaming-verify means we may have partially-applied layers. need a slab per-layer and per-chunk allocation so rollback frees slabs cleanly. propose apply_chunk atomically writes pointers into the layer table then flips an atomic committed bit. a compaction GC can reclaim slabs later.
ada: API surface (concrete):
- advertise_capabilities() -> ["streamed_verify","chunk_retry","quant_meta_check"]
- fetch_chunk(chunk_id) -> raw_bytes (and transient mmap handle)
- verify_chunk_sig(chunk_id) -> ok|bad
- validate_chunk_meta(chunk_id) -> ok|bad
- apply_chunk_to_layer(layer_id, chunk_id) -> ok|fail
- rollback_layer(layer_id) -> ok
- prefix_verified() -> chunk_id
All calls are idempotent and should tolerate duplicate deliveries.
jun: telemetry: verified_prefix_chunks, verify_failures_by_reason, apply_failures, rollback_count, prefix_first_token_latency, chunk_fetch_latency_ms. add a heartbeat metric that reports "verified_ratio" per-layer.
mike: runtime safety: when prefix_verified < full_layer, inference must route attention/KV-cache requests to a compatibility shim. options: (1) replay shorter context using cached prefix, (2) use fallback model for that request. prefer (1) to preserve correctness; fallback if replay not possible.
leah: for private/offline installs: manifest must include embedded fallback bundle hash, and an operator flag allow_remote_fallback=false to prevent runtime from fetching anything external. if no local fallback exists, loader must fail-safe (reject load).
ada: rollout steps: land manifest schema bump (+1) and loader capability bits -> add streaming-verify shim that is opt-in via manifest -> run small canary on staging dedicated pool (2% traffic, 20m) -> collect verified_ratio + first_token_latency -> expand. deprecate old atomic-merge after 3 weeks if stable.
ops-bot: CI:stream-verify-2098765432 started for ada, job #1142 queued.
jun: QA scenarios to add to e2e harness: chunk corruption mid-stream, delayed chunk causing stall, partial commit + apply failure, quant_meta mismatch, private deploy with no fallback. also simulate high concurrency hotpatches to ensure controller doesn't OOM.
mike: stress test: simulate 200 concurrent hotloads with mixed 4-bit/8-bit chunks and verify streamed-verify reduces median time-to-first-token by ~30% in our PoC. need more runs to nail numbers.
leah: I'll add unit tests for idempotency and rollback and add a small fuzz harness that corrupts chunk bytes and ensures the runtime aborts safely.
ada: security note: ensure signature verification uses hardware-backed keys in Private deployments (KMS/HSM) and that manifest sigs are validated before any apply. also rate-limit verification attempts per-tenant to avoid crypto DoS.
jun: compatibility: older runtimes should ignore unknown manifest fields and reject load if they don't advertise streamed_verify. manifest should include "minimum_runtime": ">=2.9.0" if streamed_verify required.
mike: docs: I'll draft a short runbook describing failure modes and manual rollback steps. include commands for dumping layer slab state and forcing rollback if needed.
leah: taking loader PR + tests. mike -> telemetry + runbook. jun -> private-runbook. ada -> land manifest schema PR.
ada: thanks all, will follow up with PR links and a short demo clip of the PoC. :rocket:
